mintAuthority.summary: syrupUSDT is Maple's ERC-4626 strategy-vault receipt for USDT lent to institutional borrowers; shares are minted against USDT deposits and do not create base USDT supply. The token itself is immutable, but native share pricing and mint eligibility depend on an upgradeable PoolManager. Its factory-approved upgrade path is controlled by the scheduled pool delegate or security admin. Underlying Tether issuance remains a separate inherited dependency.

controls.label: Inherited USDT (Tether) issuer mint path
controls.capDescription: The verified USDT implementation lets the current owner call issue(uint256) to increase total supply without an on-chain numeric ceiling; the binding limit is Tether's off-chain issuance and reserve process.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25584916 (2026-07-22T01:14:23Z), USDT getOwner() resolves to this 3-of-6 multisig-style owner. Tether's verified implementation exposes owner-only issue(uint256), which adds the requested amount to total supply without checking a fixed numeric cap; syrupUSDT shares inherit that base-asset authority.

controls.label: Maple syrupUSDT upgradeable PoolManager
controls.capDescription: MaplePool delegates share-mint eligibility, liquidity limits and totalAssets accounting to this upgradeable manager. A scheduled pool-delegate call or security-admin call may request an enabled factory-approved upgrade. This affects the Maple share rather than base USDT monetary issuance; the immutable deposited-asset transfer requirement and D14 bounded economics are unchanged.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26112822 (hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a), the verified MaplePool runtime matches the canonical token deployment. deposit/mint and their permit variants exclusively enter the internal _mint(shares, assets, receiver, caller), which requires nonzero assets and a successful transferFrom of the underlying from the caller; bootstrap shares also arise only within that deposit transaction. No external arbitrary-share mint or share-minter authorization exists. PoolManager permissions, liquidity limits and asset-accounting parameters do not remove the deposited-asset transfer requirement. Manager upgrade power remains the separately recorded upgrade dimension, not a D14 mint trigger. Inherited issuer controls describe parent issuance carried by the serial-claim dependency edge, not wrapper-local share minting; parent D14 risk is not charged twice.
